generation.scope: The entire rank-one scheme of every singular finite eight-cofactor member is the coincidence scheme on the projective bundle of sections through a residual point of the singular genus-one curve. Cartier four-point multiplication and relative torsion-free point ideals recover the conductor and infinitesimal lifts. Horizontal multiplicity is at most one, except for two distinct opposite scalar sections at nodal fourth torsion.

open_mathematics: Use the excess Koszul homology of the coincidence scheme and the cubic evaluation on its horizontal and vertical parts to decide all singular finite members on nonreduced windows.
